title: Drivers CRUD API with preferences (lanes, no-go zones)
description: Implement full CRUD for drivers: create (requires valid carrierId), list (paginated with carrierId filter), update (including JSON preference fields), soft-delete with active load constraint. Driver preferences (preferredLanes, noGoZones) are stored as JSON fields — validate structure on write. All endpoints scoped to org via carrier's managedByOrgId. Note: CONCERNS.md flags dispatch-api has no lint command — validationCommand excludes lint.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/v1/drivers returns 201 with driver data including generated UUID id
POST requires carrierId referencing an active (non-deleted) carrier; returns 404 if carrier not found or deleted

POST accepts all Driver model fields: name, phone, email, cdlNumber, cdlState, cdlExpiry, availableHours, currentCity, currentState, homeBaseCity, homeBaseState, maxDaysOut (default 5), preferredLanes, noGoZones, isAvailable, notes
GET /api/v1/drivers returns paginated list with default limit 25, max 100; supports ?carrierId= filter, ?search= (matches name), ?sort=&order=
PATCH /api/v1/drivers/:id accepts preferredLanes as JSON array of { originState: string, destState: string, originCity?: string, destCity?: string }
PATCH accepts noGoZones as JSON array of { state: string, city?: string }
Yup validation: each preferredLane entry requires originState and destState (2-letter state codes); each noGoZone entry requires state
Soft delete via DELETE sets deletedAt; returns 409 ConflictError with blocking load IDs if driver is assigned to a load with status before DELIVERED
All list queries filter WHERE deletedAt IS NULL
All endpoints require auth middleware; driver scoped to org via carrier.managedByOrgId
Entity IDs use uuid format (per cross-feature decision L-009)
validationCommand: cd hussle-app-dispatch-api && npx jest && npx tsc --noEmit
